interpretation: Priorities are qualitative recommendations, not measured transfer gains. Proposed fact targets require explicit visual support and compatible training adapters.

limitations: Static mobile-phone photographs
Landing page says banknotes while associated paper describes coins and paper notes; inspect object types

Archive inventory and annotation joins require checking

Generic transfer objects need not be cash
Frame clocks and cash visibility require local audit
Keep overlapping cameras/session segments in one group

Staged short atomic actions
No complete procedure supervision
Large classification archives

candidates.title: Video-based plastic bag grabbing action recognition

candidates.split_policy: Group by original recording/session; adjacent clips overlap by three seconds
limitations: Red plastic bags only
Simulated checkout
Clip-level labels lack exact temporal boundaries
Not cash-negative supervision
Parent recording identities must be recovered before independent splits

candidates.proposed_use: Cluttered and multiple-banknote appearance; instance annotation required for detection

No temporal or cash-absent labels
Reported inventory not independently counted

candidates.title: HO-Cap
candidates.proposed_use: Auxiliary tracking, contact and occlusion reasoning with static RGB views
candidates.split_policy: Group synchronized cameras and related sequences before splitting
limitations: Tabletop manipulation
No cash identity
Rigid-object pose assumptions do not model deformable banknotes
Poses and masks are generated semi-automatically, not human-reviewed bank-action boundaries
Transfer between one person's hands does not establish transfer between people
Depth/3D labels are unavailable at Forte inference time

other_deferred_sources.reason: Pose-only retail concealment release; no cash pixels or verified commercial dataset grant. Published concealment incidents are test data. Paper table resolves swapped README incident/frame columns.

integration_policy: Keep original dataset and license identity, source partition, native timestamps, content hashes and related-capture groups.
Use public TRAIN sources for proposed auxiliary fitting; preserve public validation/test roles.
Never translate purchase, shoplifting, bag-taking or generic transfer directly into a bank-law violation.
Unknown cash identity, visibility, procedural completeness and missing actions remain masked or unclear.
A frozen encoder is not updated by adding images; use a distinct object/action training route and compare each addition on fixed development data.
Keep project validation and final-check identities out of auxiliary training; this catalog grants no runner approval or compute release.
